title: Workshop Structured Review Output
description: Cannibalized from openai/codex-plugin-cc review-output.schema.json. Adapted for Workshop reviewer agent. Two-axis support (Standards+Spec, never merged) cannibalized from mattpocock/skills code-review.

verdict.description: approve: safe to ship. needs-attention: issues found but not blocking. critical-block: must fix before merge. On two-axis runs this is the MECHANICAL worst-of gate across axes (never a judgment merge) — the per-axis verdicts in `axes` carry the real information.

summary.description: Terse ship/no-ship assessment, not a neutral recap.

axes.description: REQUIRED on two-axis runs (Standards + Spec), omitted on single-axis runs. Each axis gets its own verdict; do NOT collapse them — 'Standards: approve, Spec: critical-block' is a real state the separation exists to preserve. Top-level verdict = worst of the axis verdicts, computed mechanically.

summary.description: One-line: does the code follow documented standards + smell baseline?
One-line: does the implementation do what the issue/PRD/acceptance criteria asked for?

axis.description: Which axis this finding belongs to. REQUIRED on two-axis runs, omitted on single-axis runs.

body.description: What can go wrong + why this code path is vulnerable + likely impact.

recommendation.description: Concrete change that would reduce the risk.
